rubrics.justification: It correctly references the reported 2AB and notes a full blastocyst/pre-hatching appearance, but it adds several image-specific concerns (granularity, fragmentation remnants, irregular cavity, possible re-grading) that may be fabricated or over-interpreted from a single embryo image.

It integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, tubal factor diagnosis, prior live births, sperm parameters, and day-5 status into prognosis reasonably well, though some links (e.g., low MII rate affecting this embryo's implantation potential) are somewhat overstated.

The response is structured and mostly logical, but the probability adjustment framework is somewhat ad hoc and double-counts morphology-related penalties (image concerns plus TE grade plus no PGT-A), making the final estimate less tightly supported.

SET, luteal support, and general prognostic framing are guideline-consistent, but recommending ERA after a single additional failure and strongly recommending PGT-A at age 35 with this history goes beyond standard evidence-based guidance; concern over MII rate is also somewhat speculative.

It provides clear next steps for transfer and future planning, including SET, endometrial review, embryologist confirmation, and protocol review, though some suggested tests/interventions are not strongly indicated in this specific case.
